notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
Hello!
I've updated the testing branch build of the game. I would like to introduce some of the changes:

[b]Suspension railways:[/b]
Suspension railways are using a new collision system now. These now block exactly one tile and should correctly wait for other Suspension railway cars.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900350/c4ba201a303d41df2b62abe01bc856384bd848fe.png[/img]

[b]Visual quality update:[/b]
Most 3D models in the game now have gradient textures.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900350/ff3fafd7142589747e0fecca5ae98e9041b0f9eb.png[/img]

[b]Snow system:[/b]
Originally I wanted to create scenario maps that would offer their own special content, such as new industries and special environmental conditions. I discarded the idea of ​​creating scenario maps. The snow system is a remnant that can now be activated as an option in the Custom Game Start.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900350/5dcd6ddfdc60e359cc7122e2c152877cb0f7683c.png[/img]

I've made changes to the road construction system. This can lead to problems with old savegames. I recommend starting a new game.

In addition, I fixed numerous errors and problems. I will communicate all changes soon with the update of the default branch.

[b]How do I get the testing branch build?[/b]
Select Transports in your game library and open the properties window. There you will find a beta tab where the testing branch can be selected.

Thoughts and suggestions are welcome.
Thank you for your patience and support!

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
Development Update for the upcoming version 1.16!

[b]How to get the testing branch update?[/b]
Select Transports in your Steam library and open the settings window. You'll see a Beta Tab where you can choose the "testing" entry.

Hi everyone!
I've updated the testing branch version of the game with the latest features and changes:

[b]Customizable rail waypoints[/b]
I have completely revised the rail system and built in the option of defining your own waypoints for curves and intersections (with mods). As a result, it is now possible for trains to move smoothly around curves.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900350/9cd7e48b71d146d4db1ee8ff7b177b8c355509d6.gif[/img]

[b]Diagonal tracks[/b]
Thanks to the adjustments to the rail system, diagonal tracks can now also be implemented (Curves are replaced by diagonal tracks).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900350/e570a563bdd2c544d5eb22671a636ecd6608e2df.gif[/img]

I uploaded a first mod for diagonal train tracks to the Steam Workshop.

[b]Block delivery of goods[/b]
It is now possible to block the delivery of goods to a station.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900350/dd4e9c2eebf940a541aa5d72dad3cb82d6f0ad07.jpg[/img]

[b]Exceptions for the placement of tracks[/b]
I have also implemented a system that blocks certain track constructions that shouldn't be possible.
For example:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900350/9fd20103577fcddc7573d75f936e681d7ed5a323.jpg[/img]

[b]Outlines[/b]
Outlines can now be activated in the themes. (By default, outlines are disabled in the game's standard theme)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900350/22e108c7ca03af32faa52c830b39fbf002c73ff9.jpg[/img]

[b]Bug fixes and improvements[/b]
Saved games can now be deleted from the save game menu.
In addition, an option is now available in the game start customization without starting a new game credit. 
Some problems related to goods delivery were fixed.

[b]When will the update be released on the default branch?[/b]
I'm still working on fixing some bugs. I'll release the update to the default branch in one of the following weeks.

Feel free to share your thoughts.
Thanks for your patience and support.

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
Development Update for the upcoming version 1.15b.

[b]How to get the testing branch update?[/b] 
Select Transports in your Steam library and open the settings window. You'll see a Beta Tab where you can choose the "testing" entry.

Hi everyone!
I've updated the testing branch version of the game with the latest features and changes.

[b]Changes to the UI[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900350/b54a24cea8130accf9668fd1244c000a2cbf297e.jpg[/img]
I've made changes to the UI and changed some windows. The vehicle window for example shows additional information for trailers now.

[b]Reduces save game file size[/b]

Some changes to the save game system reduce the size of save games by ~20%.

[b]Water shader[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900350/1e95ea0e84811e9d6170233005d0407599adf089.jpg[/img]
I've changed the water shader. I hope it makes a more realistic impression now.

[b]Cutscene editor[/b]

[previewyoutube=jIF6-c0rO8A;full][/previewyoutube]
One of the most time consuming things of the last months was the creation of the cutscene editor. The new tool will allow me to create small cutscenes for my games. In the video you can see a sample scene with assets from my upcoming game Tree House Survivors. I know it's not perfect, but it's a start...
In the future I would like to bring a scenario system into the game, which can then use cutscenes.

[b]Industries can be destroyed[/b]

Once you own an industry you can destroy it now. You'll find a button for that in the industry window.

[b]Headquarters[/b]

[previewyoutube=SCR9t96cVlI;full][/previewyoutube]
I've implemented a headquarters building system to the game. Originally I wanted to add a system that allows the players to buy floors which will be added to a headquarters model ingame. But I got inspired by Oskar Stålbergs Townscaper and thought a more dynamic system would be more enjoyable. I've created a voxel engine last year and used that to create a system in which players can build the headquarters block by block.  The building gets generated procedurally with each change the player makes. Take a look at the video to get an idea how it works.

[b]Industries with manufactories[/b]

Manufactories can unlock industries now. While the current standard theme in not using this feature at the moment, mods can make use of it.

[b]New clouds[/b]

[previewyoutube=y-in1ePdLkk;full][/previewyoutube]
I've replaced the static clouds with dynamic ones. I hope to increase the visual quality with it.


[b]When will the update be released on the default branch?[/b]

I'm still working on the measures from the headquarters system and have to make some changes to the UI. It'll take me some more time to finish it.


Feel free to share your thoughts.
Thanks for your patience and support.

notes.title: Development update
notes.content:
Development Update for the upcoming version 1.15a

Please note: The update is available on the default branch now.

I've updated the testing branch version of the game with the latest features.

[b]How to get the testing branch update?[/b]
Select Transports in your Steam library and open the settings window. You'll see a Beta Tab where you can choose the "testing" entry.

[b]Canals[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900350/8336a5d031f616c913044181ad69fd608a52befd.jpg[/img]
Channels can now be built in the game. Canals serve as transport routes for ships. Buoys can be built on the canals as a stop for ships.

[b]Game performance improvements[/b]
I was able to improve the performance of the game considerably. On systems with a weaker graphics card, the game can run up to 2.5x faster. The game remains CPU intensive and that is a point that I will address in the upcoming updates.

[b]ThemeSettings[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900350/601e0eb9121e47782bbc73318be9fc65a994529c.jpg[/img]
All game data are summarized in a theme definition. In this definition, certain settings can now be changed (by mods). For example, Vehicle types or certain information windows can be deactivated now.

[b]New scenario overview map[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30900350/bc37875af79e19bdd574ef404ff54342f01201ee.jpg[/img]
A system for overview maps was already implemented in the past. I have now replaced this with a new, more flexible system. In the future, the overview maps will serve as an entry point for scenarios (predefined maps with a fixed game goal). However, I will still need some time to complete the scenario system.


I've spent a lot of time improving my developer tools in the past few months. I have therefore decided to split update 1.15 into two smaller updates and thus shorten the waiting time for new content. The upcoming update 1.15b will offer, among other things, a new corporate headquarters system. With the construction of a headquarters and its expansion, additional options are unlocked, for example, with the managers.


Feel free to share your thoughts.
Thanks for your patience and support.

[b]How to get the testing branch update?[/b]
Select Transports in your Steam library and open the settings window. You'll see a Beta Tab where you can choose the "testing" entry.

Changes:

[b]Mod support[/b]
I've finished implementing the first version of Mod support for Transports. You can now extend the content for Transports by adding Mod files to the game.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30900350/66d664e7f85227be2211e7a505d5d005d42a8fd2.jpg[/img]

I've started to create a steam guide to help you with the mod creation. It will be available soon.

Steam workshop integration will follow soon too.

You need to start a new game to play with mods.

Feel free to share your thoughts.
Thanks for your patience and support.

Changes:

- you will have an option in the custom game menu to turn off train collisions

- industry tags

Every connected station to the city will loose its goods.], President visit [The presidential car is driving around with its escort in a city. The city will loose productivity for that period of time.], 2x Superstar (by car, by foot) [A superstar will drive or walk around in a city. The city will increase its productivity for that period of time.], fire [One building of a city will start burning.], UFO visit [An UFO is flying around in a city.], UFO-Overlord attack [The UFO Overlord will lift and drop buildings of a city.] and more
- fixed: industries shouldn't increase the relationship value without a connected station anymore
- station list
- improvements for the ai rail building
- 2 new signals
- by selecting a station you can see the station range now
- pin system for tasks
- graphs

notes.title: Transports • Patchnotes (1.1) ➥
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30900350/d6ab6e7418109608ec77421b4f3d1e07261709ff.png[/img]

- Update 1.1 -

Changes:
- GUI changes
- train collisions
- fixed: trains shouldn't leave the depot randomly anymore and crash into other trains
- support for biomes. I've implemented a desert biome to the standard theme.
- the ai will react to sabotage and other actions from the player
- a new manager for vehicle maintenance
- vehicles will need to be maintained
- ships will choose a more random path now (that should decrease the stacking)
- filter options
- managers will check the vehicles more frequently
- fixed: vehicles in the depot will now start their schedule correctly when changing the schedule order
- You will be able to hire staff for your vehicles. The staff can give passive improvements such as reduces breakdown times. (you need to start a new game)
- improved research window
- markings for building streets and tracks
- more advanced error information
- a new signal that checks the next three train track parts
- several bug fixes related to signals
- industries will now automatically increase or decrease their production capacity by building additional buildings
- fixed: a bug related to the deletion of the signal type 2
- trains will choose alternative routes more often
- hold the left shift key to level the terrain while building streets and tracks
- hold the left shift key to add streets and tracks at the ends of bridges and tunnels while building them
- The company headquarter represents the player rank now.
- You won't pay double anymore if you build over existing infrastructure.
- fixed: planes shouldn't return to the airport they are depart


Please note:
Trains will no longer choose a new route if the train is in a tunnel or on a bridge. There was a problem with reserved track sections which were no longer released when a train was on a bridge or in a tunnel.

[h1]Next Development Update for 1.1[/h1]

[b]How to get the testing branch update?[/b]
Select Transports in your Steam library and open the settings window. You'll see a Beta Tab where you can choose the "testing" entry.

[b]New: Industry upgrades[/b]
The industries will grow over time and increase their production capacity if the goods are well transported away at the connected stations.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30900350/7ad0b7ef4d16b10e6794625631fce65e9c02afe5.png[/img]

notes.title: Discount and development update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30900350/d6ab6e7418109608ec77421b4f3d1e07261709ff.png[/img]

[h1]Discount[/h1]

Don't miss your chance on the Transports discount in the Steam Store. :)

[h1]Development Update for 1.1[/h1]

I've uploaded the latest version onto the testing branch for testing.

[b]How to get the testing branch update?[/b]
Select Transports in your Steam library and open the settings window. You'll see a Beta Tab where you can choose the "testing" entry.

[b]New: Maintenance and reliability [/b]
Vehicles will age and lose reliability now. You need to send them to the depot to reset their condition. There is also a new manager for this.

[b]New: Train collisions[/b]
Trains will collide now. 
The faster train, or the train that gets checked first if they are at the same speed, will destroy the slower train. Depending on the train condition the faster train will also be destroyed.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30900350/471a88c923fbbca24c4fe9b2122094b76292ffb5.jpg[/img]

[b]New: Biomes[/b]
The game now supports biomes. For testing the new functionality I've added a desert biome to the standard theme.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30900350/a7b5bebd96944a1de10a5f08d453b2244b631aa9.jpg[/img]

[b]New: Opponent reactions[/b]
Opponents will now react to the player. This is limited to sabotage at the moment but will be extended with the next updates.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30900350/0fde3c87a7711a80df4c48848cb809d410a9ddc0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Transports • Patchnotes (1.09) ➥
notes.content:
Changes:
- trains will choose a new platform when they waited for too long at a signal
- fixed: the station capacity was not recalculated after a bunch of goods expired or got deleted from the station
- fixed: money that the player will earn throught the transportation of goods that are about to expire will be calculated correcty now. That will lead to unprofitable transportation routes. Make sure to build routes with vehicles that are able to deliver goods in time. For long routes it will be necessary to build freight stations were the goods will be stored and their expiry timer will be reset. There is a station upgrade available for that.
- GUI changes
- fixed: a bug where train objects couldn't be removed
- fixed: vehicles will now no longer choose the wrong schedule entry
- trams can't switch rails on one tile anymore. You have to update your tram networks.
- tutorial task system
- compendium

- the steam avatar will now be used ingame
- the minimap will now show the current camera location on opening
- small objects will now be invisible when zooming out
- vehicles will now start with a short delay from the depot


Thanks for your support!
